name: DISCOVERY_SERIAL_DEPENDENCE_SIGN_SEQUENCE_TOURNAMENT

rationale.stage0010_outcome: 0 robust leads across 51 local completed-bar morphology / short pattern-state hypotheses
rationale.structural_change: move to price-direction serial dependence defined only by close-to-close sign sequences; no magnitude, range, wick, breakout, or ATR-regime trigger
rationale.why_hold_horizons_are_longer: stage0010 H2/H4 local-pattern results were strongly negative after costs; this family tests a distinct serial structure at H8/H24/H72 without micro-tuning failed local-bar thresholds

signal_definition.price_sign: sign(close[t]-close[t-1]) on completed H1 bars only; zero-return bars invalidate a sequence
signal_definition.streak: last N close-to-close signs are identical and non-zero
signal_definition.alternation: last N close-to-close signs are non-zero and strictly alternate
signal_definition.continuation: trade in direction of final sign

event_rules.entry: next available H1 bar open after completed sign-sequence signal
event_rules.exit: fixed number of instrument H1 bars later
event_rules.cooldown: hold_bars; one active event per instrument/config
event_rules.atr: simple ATR14 at signal only for normalization; ATR is not a trigger
event_rules.cost: observed entry spread converted to price and divided by ATR14

neighbor_definition: same family; exactly one parameter moves one adjacent predefined grid step; good if equal-symbol mean>0, stress2>0, pooled trim1>0

ranking: highest robustness_floor = min(stress3_equal_symbol, trim5_pooled, half1_equal_symbol, half2_equal_symbol)

next_if_frozen: STAGE0012 extracts validation pool only and applies exact frozen candidate; no discovery retuning
next_if_no_lead: continue discovery with another structurally distinct family; validation stays locked
